title: DeepGOPlus: improved protein function prediction from sequence
why_relevant: Establishes a strong, reproducible hybrid recipe: deep sequence model for frequent terms plus sequence-similarity transfer for additional terms, aligned with CAFA-style evaluation.
extracted_technique: Train a convolutional motif model on sequence-only inputs and combine its outputs with similarity-based annotation transfer to improve Fmax while keeping inference fast.
query: DeepGOPlus sequence similarity convolutional neural network GO term prediction paper
takeaway: A hybrid of sequence motif learning and neighbor-based transfer is a proven high-performing structure for CAFA-like metrics and fits Kaggle constraints when trained only on provided sequences/labels.

title: CAFA-evaluator: a Python tool for benchmarking ontological classification methods
why_relevant: Provides an official-style implementation of CAFA metrics (including weighted scores with IA) needed for reliable offline validation/threshold tuning.
extracted_technique: Use ontology parsing + ancestor propagation + threshold sweep to compute weighted Fmax; weighted scores require providing the IA file; includes options for propagation strategy and normalization.
query: CAFA evaluation code weighted fmax python
takeaway: Use CAFA-evaluator (or replicate its key steps) to keep validation metric-aligned with leaderboard scoring and to tune calibration/thresholds safely.

title: cafaeval (CAFA-evaluator)
why_relevant: Practical installation/usage reference for implementing weighted-Fmax evaluation with IA.tsv and GO OBO; clarifies key parameters like propagation strategy and threshold step.
extracted_technique: Run evaluation with IA file to produce weighted curves; configure propagation as max; sweep thresholds (th_step) and optionally limit max terms per protein.
query: IA.tsv weighted Fmax implementation CAFA evaluation GitHub
takeaway: The package documents the exact knobs needed for weighted evaluation and is a good reference even if you later reimplement a minimal evaluator for speed or dependency constraints.

title: Rostlab/EAT: Embedding-based annotation transfer
why_relevant: Shows that nearest-neighbor transfer in embedding space is a validated approach for protein annotation; we can adapt the idea using competition-only embeddings (k-mer/projection) to avoid external pretrained weights.
extracted_technique: Compute per-protein embeddings, retrieve nearest labeled proteins, and transfer annotations based on distance/similarity; optionally use efficient indexing for scale.
query: embedding based annotation transfer protein embeddings nearest neighbor GO
takeaway: A strong, scalable baseline for huge label spaces is retrieval + label transfer; this is especially suitable when you must avoid external data and still cover many GO terms.
